context: A police officer briefs a manager about office security
purpose: Teach: 市役所/フロア/洗練/ハードディスク/大物/スマート/本題/紙面

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 市役所への申請、防犯計画も添付してください。
lines.en: Please attach a crime-prevention plan when you submit the application to city hall.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Even tone. Clear instruction without pressure. The voice of someone used to giving directions that need to stick.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。各フロアに洗練されたカメラ、配置しています。
lines.en: Yes, of course. We have sophisticated cameras positioned on each floor.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. Slight lift on the detail—showing she's thought this through. Steady, competent. The tone of someone presenting work they stand behind.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本題は、ハードディスク等の保管です。
lines.en: The main issue is storage—hard drives and sensitive documents.
lines.style: Shift to business. Slightly sharper focus. This is the real concern. Level, no-nonsense delivery. Pause weight before the colon.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 大物来訪時にも対応できるスマートな仕様です。
lines.en: It's a smart setup—we're ready even for high-profile visits.
lines.style: Confident, not defensive. Slight pride in the detail. Forward-leaning tone. Sells the solution quietly, letting the work speak.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 紙面に出ない地味な対策こそ大事です。
lines.en: The unglamorous measures—the ones that don't make the news—those are what actually matter.
lines.style: Quiet weight on the second phrase. Knowing tone. A soft but firm reminder, not lecturing. The steady voice of someone who has seen what happens when people skip the boring part.
